text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, thank you~! The metal keychain 
was a wonderful birthday present~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A sparkling item will boost your 
intuition! The feng shui and design are 
both flawless! You put so much thought 
into picking it out, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You're the one who wouldn't shut up 
about feng shui day in and day out, so of 
course it got stuck in my head!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Even when it comes to design, thanks to 
her, I've ended up knowing way too much 
about it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I see~! He has such wonderful taste 
and is such a great person. Your dad, that 
is, Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As if! If anything, it was a total 
pain!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Don't worry, I understand. From 
the bottom of your heart, Espo-san... Our 
deeply connected biorhythms, those warm 
waves...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I know! To thank you for today, I want to 
help you out next! Like picking out a 
birthday present for your dad☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Your environment and house fortune 
influence your heart, you know. Little 
items are the key to getting Copatto-close 
with someone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides... with the power of Feng Shui, I 
can pick out a present in a flash, you 
know? Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Easy-peasy Happy☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch, fine, alright! It's not like I've 
got time to waste on that guy anyway. I 
just gotta go with ya, right? Let's go!"
